steps: Build in a worktree (Sonnet minion) (45 min)
Review the diff, smoke, merge (15 min)
Restart Servex, prove on two real tasks (20 min)
Docs, mastermind skill line, finish-task (15 min)
assign.now: plan written; spawning the build minion

log.msg: before: 116 tasks in 7 days, 15 with steps (13%), 0 with estimates; 11 of 14 landed-with-steps reached the last step (79%). TaskLoop walks only ai/YYYY-MM-DD/, so it chases nothing in the sessions store.

decision.question: where the steps live
decision.chose: task.jsonl assign.steps as strings ending '(N min)'
decision.why: every reader already reads it; strings keep the board checklist working
decision.alternative: a steps section in plan.md parsed by node
